notes: GLiFormer Large v1 NER LiteRT (litert-community/GLiFormer-Large-NER-LiteRT, published 2026-09-26, Hub revision dee6ced): the entity-extraction path of knowledgator/gliformer-large-v1 (rev d0a4e53d; DeBERTa-large 24-layer encoder + word BiLSTM + span scorer, 5 labels), window N=128 encoded tokens, T=48 text words; inputs inputs_embeds [1,128,1024] / attention_mask [1,128] / text_routing [1,48,128] / parent_routing [1,1,128] / label_routing [1,5,128] / text_mask [1,48] float32, output output_0 [1,1,48,15] (start/end/inside logits per word x label); the host looks up the word embeddings before the graph (host_assets/word_embeddings_fp32.bin, or the fp16 table upcast to float32) and decodes the logits with the upstream pairing decoder after it. wfp16 storage: 153 float16 weight tensors (the FULLY_CONNECTED weights, Hub card) read through a DEQUANTIZE to float32, everything else float32 (4,149 operators vs 3,996 in the fp32 reference graph; no integer quantization). GpuOptions(precision = FP32) is the validated Android setting; with GpuOptions omitted (the runtime's default GPU precision) the s128 wfp16 graph compiled and returned finite logits but 0/10 entity span sets (recorded in the s128 wfp16 file). artifact_sha256 = the on-device sha256 of the pushed file (the run directory's *_hash_*.stdout.log), equal to the Hub LFS sha256 (resolve URL x-linked-etag, read 2026-09-26), public/manifest.json and the local public/ copy. Every number read programmatically from the lane's JSONs / raw outputs (build script kept in the session scratchpad); peak_mem_mb = the process VmHWM in bytes / 1e6 (the bytes are in metrics); model-level facts only, no op row derives from these records.
